name: Einhander (Combat)
body:
With grace, you sweep through your enemies with a single blade.

Benefit(s): As long as you are only wielding a light or onehanded weapon in one hand and no other weapons or shields in your off-hand(s), you gain a +2 dodge bonus to your armor class.

In addition, once per round when a creature within your weapon’s reach misses you with a melee attack while you are wielding a light or one-handed weapon in one hand and no other weapons or shields in your off-hand(s), you may make an attack of opportunity against that creature.

Akashic Classes: Kheshig © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Anthony Cappel.
